property_location: Thudiyalur, Mettupalayam Road, Near NGGO Colony, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
verified_facts: Project name is Shree Aishwarya Garden located at Senkali Palayam near Thudiyalur and Saravanampatti, Coimbatore., The 2-acre development comprises 40 DTCP-approved residential plots across Phase 1 and Phase 2., Plot sizes range from 2 cents, 2.25 cents, to 2.5 cents., Plot pricing is fixed at ₹14.5 Lakhs per cent., Up to 90% bank loan approval available through tie-ups with banks including HDFC, LIC, and Punjab National Bank., Custom house construction packages are offered starting at an overall budget of ₹50 Lakhs.

content_plan.style: Relaxed, conversational local property presenter speaking directly to camera
content_plan.hook_strategy: Highlight DTCP-approved plot availability in prime Thudiyalur near Saravanampatti IT Park

scenes.name: location
scenes.voice: Coimbatore Thudiyalur, NGGO Colony பக்கத்துல Saravanampatti IT Park கிட்ட Shree Aishwarya Garden அமைஞ்சிருக்கு.

scenes.name: land
scenes.voice: 2 ஏக்கர் gated community-ல, 2 cent, 2.25 cent மற்றும் 2.5 cent அளவுகள்ல 40 residential plots இருக்கு.

scenes.name: facing
scenes.voice: இதுல North மற்றும் East facing plots இருக்கு. Tar road, water pipeline, compound wall, street lights எல்லாமே அமைச்சு குடுக்குறாங்க.

scenes.name: approval
scenes.voice: இது DTCP approval பெற்ற site. HDFC, LIC, Punjab National Bank மூலமா 90% வரை bank loan வசதியும் இருக்கு.

scenes.name: price
scenes.voice: விலை பாத்தீங்கனா per cent ₹14.5 Lakhs. Custom house construction பண்ணணும்னா overall budget ₹50 Lakhs-ல இருந்தும் start ஆகுது.

scenes.name: cta
scenes.voice: நேரடியா site visit வரவும் மத்த details தெரிஞ்சுக்கவும் உடனே call பண்ணுங்க.
